violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CHANGING GLOVES AFTER HANDLING RAW MEAT WITHOUT WASHING HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE GLOVES, WASH HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CUT LETTUCE AT 57F, ARUGULA AT 55F IN VEVOR 3 DOOR PREP TOP (EXPO); RAW GROUND BEEF AT 43F IN MIGALI 2 DOOR FLAT TOP; RAW GROUND BEEF AT 45F IN OMCAN RAIL; RAW CHICKEN AT 46F IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR; FRUIT CREAM ROLL AT 44F, CHOCOLATE CREAM ROLL AT 50F, TURKEY & CHEESE SANDWICH AT 53F IN DISPLAY (FRONT SERVICE-MIDDLE); YOGURT BEVERAGE AT 44F IN DISPENSER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. RAW MEATS WERE TRANSFERRED TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW; ALL OTHER FOODS WERE DISCARDED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: BEEF AND LAMB OFFERINGS AND SEVERAL ITEMS WITH EGGS SERVED UNDERCOOKED OR RAW ON UPDATED MENU.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE UPDATE ALL ANIMAL PROTEINS ON MENU WHICH MAY BE SERVED UNDERCOOKED OR RAW WITH ASTERISKS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PURCHASE PROBE FOOD THERMOMETERS DURING INSPECTION. PIC PLACED ONLINE ORDER.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: BUCKET OF OLIVES AND TAHINI IN EXPO AREA; FLOUR, OIL AND ONIONS IN BACK STORAGE AREA STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE FOODS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counters OPPOSITE COOK LINE AND PIZZA STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE PREPARED SANITIZER BUCKETS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE..

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT START OF INSTRUCTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING. INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING. DURING PREPARATION PERIODS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW EGGS STORED ABOVE CREAM CHEESE IN SIR LAWRENCE 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR; RAW BEEF OVER VEGETABLES IN OMCAN 2 DOOR FLAT TOP
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REORGANIZE FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE TRAINING AND CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE RAW GROUND BEEF IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: ROLLED BOREK AND BOREK WITHOUT 4 HOUR TIME LABELS IN DISPLAY FRONT SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO APPLY LABELS 8:30-12:30 DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: LENTIL SOUP AT 44-47F IN DEEP COVERED CONTAINERS PREPARED THE PREVIOUS DAY IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE PROPER COOLING METHODS ARE USED TO RAPIDLY COOL FOODS FROM 135F ATO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS. violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: VARIOUS SOUPS, SAUCES, BABA GANOUSH, ROASTED EGGPLANT, HUMMUS AND TZATZIKI IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR PREPARED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: LENTIL SOUP AT 44-47F IN DEEP COVERED CONTAINERS PREPARED THE PREVIOUS DAY IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE SMALLER PORTIONS, SHALLOW PANS OR ICE WANDS IN FREEZER ARE USED TO RAPIDLY COOL FOODS TO THE PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name

violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOODS REMOVED FROM ORIGINAL PACKAGING ARE LABELED WITH AT LEAST THE COMMON NAME. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: RAW MARINATED CHICKEN OVER LAMB AND BEEF IN SIR LAWRENCE 1 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR; RAW CHICKEN OVER RAW BEEF AND FISH IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REORGANIZE MEATS BY COOK TEMPERATURE DURING INSPECTION. EHS WILL FORWARD ADDITIONAL GUIDANCE DOCUMENTATION TO BE USED FOR TRAINING STAFF.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: RASPBERRY CAKE AT 47F IN CAKE DISPLAY (MIDDLE) AND BOREK 67F, MINI PIZZA 70F IN DISPLAY IN FRONT SERVICE AREA
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC AGREED TO USE CAKE FOR DISPLAY PURPOSES ONLY AND NOT TO BE SOLD TO CUSTOMERS. PIC DISCARDED BOREK AND MINI PIZZA DURING INSPECTION. PIC DECIDED SAVORY BAKED GOODS IN DISPLAY WITHOUT TEMPERATURE CONTROL WILL USE TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL. EHS WILL FORWARD DOCUMENTATION TO PIC.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED FROZEN SEA BASS IN REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING (ROP) THAWING IN SEALED PACKAGES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE FISH FROM SEALED PACKAGES TO COMPLETE THE THAWING PROCESS IN THE WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: BOTTLES OF SAUCES AND OILS, SPICES OPPOSITE COOK LINE AND BACK EXPO AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter: PREP TOP IN MAIN KITCHEN AND PREP COUNTERS IN BAKERY.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECT IMMEDIATELY. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED AT NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: KNIVES STORED BETWEEN PREP TOPS NEAR GRILL LINE/COOK LINE; BAKERY UTENSILS STORED BETWEEN COUNTERS IN BAKERY
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEES TO REMOVE UTENSILS TO BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED.
